ownership: StudyRenderEngine.shared = StudyRenderEngine() selects the ordinary initializer. Its closure obtains MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice and creates MetalStudyRenderer. Eligible, uncached sphere startup calls validate before state becomes metal.
Real validate loops all six canonical fixtures at width48 against ReferenceStudyRenderer and StudyParityMetrics.passes. Strict8 is a separate acceptance matrix, not an additional startup loop.

The makeComputeBackend initializer is an explicit opt-in test seam. It is internal source, not #if DEBUG-gated or compiler-enforced test-only. Contract requires a fresh backend for exclusive actor use; a malicious or mistaken factory can retain/share a reference. Synchronous StudyComputeBackend methods avoid suspension/transfers in actor calls but alone do not prove exclusivity.
The actor owns factory invocation, validation, backend selection and cache mutation. Additional cancellation is ORed with Task.isCancelled and cannot suppress task cancellation.

Production cancellation checkpoints emit StudyError.cancelled. Generic Swift CancellationError from an injected backend is caught as backend failure and selects CPU, even though the consumer publication seam also recognizes CancellationError as cancellation.

The synchronous actor render method has no await between the final cooperative cancellation check, insertion and return. External cancellation after the last observed false check is not atomic with admission; no GPU preemption is promised.
Caller owns task/generation invalidation and paired image/backend/mask-warning/error adoption after awaiting and conversion. Cache eviction cannot revoke copies held by a caller.

oracleAndPacking.tinyOutputSemantics: For each positive emitter, count is quality.grid squared for rectangles and1 otherwise. If light.candela / Double(count) < Double.leastNormalMagnitude, Sample.outputScale becomes light.candela and samples are generated from a unit-intensity emitter. CPU evaluate accumulates each point/directional sample or contiguous rectangle as one group, then restores lux/visibleLux/XYZ by outputScale once and adds the prior totals. Ordinary outputScale1 preserves ordinary arithmetic/order.
oracleAndPacking.packingChange: computeSamples first-row w changes from s.candela to s.candela * s.outputScale before Float conversion. It restores original per-sample intensity rather than exposing normalized unit intensity. Tiny values can still become Float32 zero.
oracleAndPacking.earlyCancellation: Private StudySetup adds isCancelled default false and checks it after resolution validation, before camera validation/sample allocation. ReferenceStudyRenderer passes its predicate; StudyComputeInput public initializer is unchanged and continues using default false. Production Metal wrapper already has its own pre-construction check.
